notes.title: Announcing Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="OhmruQk28MI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]“You’re trapped in a dream. And the only way out is to go deeper in.”[/i][/p][p]Have you ever had a nightmare, where you knew you were dreaming… but couldn’t wake up?
Same operating system. Same browser. Same illegal websites.
But something’s off.[/p][p]And then you start to remember. And then you start to panic.
The line between dream and reality fades as you search for an exit.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare[/b] is a spiritual successor to [i]Project DeepWeb[/i] — darker, gloomier, and more immersive than ever. Discover what happened after your visit to the Silent House — and why everything now feels… wrong.
This game features new apps, new levels of the Internet, and entirely new ways to interact with ReduxOS.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare[/b] scheduled for release in late 2025. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756870"]Add to wishlists[/url], follow us on [url="https://x.com/nightcatstudios"]X[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/nightcatstudios.com"]Bluesky[/url] and [url="https://instagram.com/nightcatstudios"]Instagram[/url] and join our [url="https://nightcat.eu/discord"]Discord server[/url] to stay in touch with us and be first to know about updates.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756870/Project_DeepWeb_Eternal_Nightmare"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
[p][i]Our descent into the nightmare is far from over.
We’ve left something behind... and it’s waiting for you.
[b]DON’T. EVEN. BLINK.[/b][/i][/p][p][b]Watch the announcement of the next entry in the Project DeepWeb series — July 1st, 6 PM GMT.[/b][/p][previewyoutube="OhmruQk28MI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Celebrating Project DeepWeb 5th Anniversary
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2A_cjjm-ktA;full][/previewyoutube]

On April 15th 2020, we released Project DeepWeb - our first game. It’s been 5 years since then. 5 years, full of very different events. And today, 5 years later, we're proud to release The Final Update for Project DeepWeb.

[h1]Wait! What about Eternal Nightmare?[/h1]

We’re proud to announce that Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare outgrew original Project DeepWeb and [b]will be released this year as a standalone expansion[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/9d2b60ecc88c424309e780785cb25108a8a93969.png[/img]

We know, we promised it for free, but now Eternal Nightmare is even more than Project DeepWeb itself! It has so much content and features that we even decided to release it on consoles and other platforms as well.

We’ll share more details about Eternal Nightmare and show first real trailer very soon. So stay tuned and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/nightcatstudios]Twitter[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/nightcatstudios.com]Bluesky[/url] (yeah, we have Bluesky) and [url=https://instagram.com/nightcatstudios]Instagram[/url]. And join our [url=https://nightcat.eu/discord]Discord server[/url].

[h1]Trading Cards and Point Shop Items[/h1]
Thanks to Steam for providing their platform and trusting us, now Project DeepWeb has Trading Cards, Badges and Backgrounds. Especially backgrounds – we can’t wait to see them on your profiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/bb67a3b68cbb4309a4b1be8e810ecbd50e15c61d.png[/img]

Also, we’ve made a few [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/975620]Point Shop items[/url], they’re very cool too! You know what to do with them :P

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]

To anyone who played Project DeepWeb, contributing to the content, being active in our community and waiting for our upcoming games, we want to sincerely thank you. We've met lots of great people and discovered lots of new games since then. We may not have Best Indie Game statuette at Game Awards... or any other award, but your reviews on Steam are the best trophy we could ever get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/b2e48bb8f2b53042b06d1e3647d12b544f096134.png[/img]

[h1]And now to the update![/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Project was updated to Unity 6. 
[*] First Time Setup screen now appears only at first launch of the game.
[*] Ending monologue was fixed in English and Ukrainian versions.
[*] Credits were reworked considering updates in development team.
[*] Discord Rich Presence support (which caused random crashes) was removed.
[*] Bug with selected scrollable text fields was fixed.
[*] Date was removed from the taskbar.
[*] Rafflesia now handles server addresses even with the slash symbol in the end.
[*] ETTDI now can’t be closed nor minimized when The Executor of Desires scan is in progress.
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

[h2]New Features in Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Default user picture was replaced.
[*] In levels D, C and B desktop icons now are highlighted on mouse hover.
[*] In Downloads, images now can be opened in fullscreen
[*] Level A now has 256 colors effect.
[*] Music now mutes when b-rolls video is playing.
[*] Endings were re-edited.
[/list]

[h2]New Features not in Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Project DeepWeb is now available on Linux
[*] Artbook is now part of the game and is available to anyone. 
[list]
[*] Therefore Project DeepWeb: Artbook DLC is no longer available for purchase
[*] Old artbook is now available as “Project DeepWeb Artbook Legacy” in “Tools” section of the Steam library.
[/list]
[*] Main menu was redesigned.
[*] Extras menu is now available after finishing the game for the first time. Here you can find:
[list]
[*] Game Credits
[*] PDW: The Beginning Mockumentary
[*] Artbook
[/list]
[*] Other minor UX improvements 
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Density Limit
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, fellas. Happy holidays![/b] 
As you know, besides big updates for Project DeepWeb, for the last few years we've been working on a big ambitious project that was in development for a really long time. FInally we're ready to reveal it to you!

[previewyoutube=pjoqkoxMzLY;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome to a whole new world. It has a lot of names but we call it the Unspace. We're not gonna lie, it’s a little scary there, but it’s very attractive for scientists and kind of mysterious as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/54f0fc46890888a3b04d6bc5967b6967631754c6.png[/img]

But what is the limit of this space? What happened here and why does it even exist? And what’s more exciting is why it’s so messed up? Your mission will be to solve this case.

[b]Density Limit[/b] is a cinematic puzzle game in development by NightCat Studios. Demo will be available on Steam in 2023. We'll share more info about this game later, so don't forget to follow our [url=https://twitter.com/nightcatstudios]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://nightcat.eu/discord]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: What's going on? Volume 27
notes.notes:
Hi folks, Dan here, and welcome to 27th episode of our every-never digest "What's up, NightCat?". Today we're gonna talk about our latest news from world of Project DeepWeb and its creators.

[h1]New update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/56852bc1819ea12af99b02ac1078ad5dab549dc7.png[/img]

We're working on big story update for Project DeepWeb.

If it was a secret for you, you're definitely not a member of [url=https://go.nightcatstudios.com/discord]our cozy Discord-server[/url], so welcome, only 998 246* seats are left.

To be serious, await for scary, much scarier and the scariest things. And it's all in next 365 days! You won't miss it, because we'll tell you about it in person, on streets of your city.

[i]* - but we can change our mind[/i]

[h1]Ukrainian localization[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/6a77ebd15bddd01b2bb2b4144e21918c1081f099.png[/img]

Someone from our studio had a dream, that all our games will be released with Ukrainian localization inside. And can you believe it, dreams come true, so here you go — introducing full localization for Project DeepWeb in Ukrainian, language of the bravest people on Earth and our producer Lex.

Only one person is working on this localization, so we don't know when it'll be released, but await it this year.

[h1]Creative contest[/h1]
Prepare your photoshops and get ready: we're launching very interesting contest with awesome prizes from the universe of Project DeepWeb. Coming soon.

[h1]Our next project[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/aff54643f1a49d155afecde0828ee98ff2259544.png[/img]

We're pleased to announce that development of NightCat Studios next project is in full swing. We don't want to spoil, but this game will feature such innovative** things as: [b]walking[/b] and [b]jumps[/b].
We can't wait to show you, what we've worked at over last few years, so when it happens, a lot of tears and champagne will be spilled, oh yeah. Date of this event will be announced later — don't miss it!

[i]** - innovative for NightCat Studios projects[/i]

[h1][/h1]
There you have it, folks. Stay tuned, or you can sit tuned, we don't mind. Subscribe to our channels and don't forget to keep your homes tidy, because we didn't. And now we can't find a gamepad and that's why we can't add gamepad support for Project DeepWeb.

notes.title: Nothing New Update
notes.notes:
You haven't heard from us these past months. And you'll ask us: what were you doing all this time and where is story update for Project DeepWeb?

We'll answer that it wasn't wasted time and we're ready to introduce you the biggest ever Project DeepWeb Big Update... judging by amount of new features that we [b]did not include[/b] in the game. Introducing "Nothing New Update"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/c1c213a8bcbd94adb4437ae8cb47a28c3e68429f.png[/img]

Eastertide, that is right now, by the way, inspired us to add an easter egg to the game. And we did it, can you believe it?
We don't remember why, but then we decided to remove it and it was harder and longer than adding it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/709572efffe854b7ee0cbba2e483808dcb182c35.png[/img]

One morning we thought, what else we could bring to the game, that could be new and cool. And can you believe, 'till the evening we didn't invent anything so we concluded that our game is perfect already. What a productive day!

And all this is so you could get the best ever Project DeepWeb Update!

By the way, we've prepared useful infographics:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/f1a42e3a78fbc450263a00088742819f5443be22.png[/img]

And, you know, minor improvements. We switched to new version of engine, so game works on macOS both Intel and Apple Siliclon, and now you can skip cinematics.

Well, that's all. Don't forget to join our discord server and leave your thoughts here. We will definitely read them! :)

Stay safe and destroy expectations, not the cities.
And yep, happy Project DeepWeb's 2nd anniversary!

notes.title: #StandWithUkraine
notes.notes:
On 24th of February 2022, Russian Federation and Vladimir Putin has officially declared war on Ukraine.

We always declared ourselves as international creative studio, but majority of our team are from Ukraine. Fortunately, all of Ukrainian devs from NightCat Studios are in safe places, there is no threat for their lives. We hope you are safe too.

We're donating all of our recent revenue from Project DeepWeb to the Red Cross Organization to help victims of the war. [url=https://www.icrc.org/en/donate/ukraine]Support too[/url]

If you need psychological help, join our [url=https://go.nightcatstudios.com/discord]discord server[/url]. There is always someone from our team and/or friends to support and listen to you.

We address this message to players, bloggers, journalists and our colleagues. Do not stay aside and help those in need.

Stay safe and destroy expectations, not cities.
Дякуємо за вашу підтримку // Thank you for your support

notes.title: English version of Project DeepWeb is here!
notes.notes:
Yeah, the translation is now available. Now it’s really a showtime: Silent House is ready to receive guests from all over the world!

We must say that translation, however, wasn’t done by professionals. We do think it is good enough for you to enjoy the adventure, but sometimes it can be a bit quirky. So for some time there will be a «Submit a problem» button in the game, therefore in case you find something wrong with texts or with a game itself, you can let us now and we’ll fix it as soon as possible.

On this occasion we want to say thanks to our [url=https://go.nightcatstudios.com/discord]Discord server[/url] users for helping us out with the translation and other testing: because of them the game became a lot better. You can join too, by the way! :)

It almost feels like a second release, and we really hope that you will enjoy the game. Thank you for your interest – and for your patience!

[b]There will be a discount in a few hours! Better wait a bit to buy a game :)[/b]

notes.title: ReduxOS 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello. My name is Alex Sorokin, I am CEO Redux Corporation.  We're so thrilled to announce our brand new ReduxOS 2.0 Update.

[previewyoutube=CfGV-aKNGYw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Shortcuts[/h2]
You asked us, so now you will not need mouses — there is no thing you can't do with only keyboard.
[list]
[*] Open browser tab (Ctrl+T)
[*] Close browser tab (Ctrl+W)
[*] Restore closed browser tab (Ctrl+Shift+T)
[*] Close program (Ctrl+Q)
[*] Minimize program (Ctrl+M)
[*] Switch active window (Ctrl+Tab)
[*] Minimize all windows (Ctrl+D)
[/list]

[h2]Notepad[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/13f4f8ae4ffac86979b5cb4c86c07eae410946d3.png[/img]
Notepad would seem like ideal, but we found what to improve, take a look:
[list]
[*] You can split your text to different notes.
[*] Also it's dark now, like any good app.
[/list]

[h2]Downloads[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/079c663e82c9ef09f413783cd96031b2c22aa717.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Now you can search files by name ([i]a m a z i n g[/i]).
[*] You can add files to Favorites and filter them from other files.
[*] Also now it supports audio and video files. Who knows, maybe you'll find some.
[/list]

[h2]Terminal[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35346397/9595f9b5957c5e0bf138fbe4da77057aae961aa6.png[/img]
It is definitely the most important part of OS. And damn, it's better now!
[list]
[*] File System — now you can view your files right from prompt.
[*] We made it more beautiful and more comfortable. Come on, give it a try!
[*] You can use s_talk to talk to some random strangers.
[*] Also, we've added GLOBAL CHAT! Every ReduxOS user can connect to it and talk to thousands of users. Sounds cool, isn't it?
[/list]

[h2]A few more things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Jointly with Alexandr "trck" Toretsky, we re-made FTP Server Viewer in ETTDI. Now you can preview text files and images.
[*] While [i]some[/i] companies stop support of 32-bit games, we're adding it. Now you can fire up some simple games on ReduxOS.
[*] As always, [i]some minor improvements.[/i]
[/list]

That's all great, of course, but just in case, system may work unstable. So if you've got any problems, feel free to reach us at our [url=https://discord.gg/cpC3W26]Discord server[/url].

Also, we're now working on english language pack for ReduxOS, so stay tuned for the fresh updates!

Thank you for the insterest in our gam... I mean, operating system. Yeah, system. What game are we talking about?
